intent: Create one Arena-owned post-merge evidence-ratification witness for PR #983. Bind the witness to current origin/main, preserve the historical arena-live-controls-WP-O20 packet byte-for-byte, distinguish its valid canonical digest from its invalid binding to the final PR event base/head envelope, record final merge/check/review facts, and preserve the no-live-provider, no-capability-claim, no-promotion, and no-retroactive-approval boundary. This packet authorizes only the new witness and its own tracked copy; it does not edit ACTIVE_TRACK, generated projections, Arena runtime/tests, Mike surfaces, or terminal surfaces.

gates.name: arena-current-main-regression-suite
gates.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_arena_v1.py tests/test_arena_parity_controls.py tests/test_dpi.py tests/test_orchestration_genome.py tests/test_orchestrator_v1.py tests/test_council_profiles.py tests/test_coordination_closure_checks.py tests/test_arena_truth_report.py -q

negative_controls.name: historical-packet-digest-valid-but-final-base-binding-invalid
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import copy,hashlib,json,sys; p='reports/agentops/work_packets/arena-live-controls-WP-O20.json'; d=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8')); recorded=d['session_entry']['packet_digest']; canonical=copy.deepcopy(d); canonical['session_entry'].pop('packet_digest'); computed=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(canonical,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(); final_base='e22ffe5db6884a3d315291ba5fb252e8fe80d8b5'; mismatch=d['base_ref']!=final_base or d['session_entry']['collision']['checked_at_sha']!=final_base; sys.exit(3 if recorded==computed and mismatch else 7)"

commit.message: docs(arena): ratify PR 983 post-merge evidence boundary

interface_mismatches: The historical WP-O20 packet remains internally digest-valid at current main, but its base_ref and collision binding are 1d45916d338c106a1e379d928b979f78c17ca489 while PR #983's final event base/head were e22ffe5db6884a3d315291ba5fb252e8fe80d8b5 and 258ac62453e3f8d313792ab24a7d0757904facf7.
PR #983's green AgentOps packet-scope job reported packet_paths=[], required=false, and status=NOT_REQUIRED, so it did not validate WP-O20 against the final PR event envelope.

GitHub records nine formal reviews, all COMMENTED, and no formal review submitted on final head 258ac62453e3f8d313792ab24a7d0757904facf7; no exact-head APPROVED evidence is present in the queried GitHub record.
honest_blockers: This is a post-merge descriptive witness, not retroactive pre-merge approval and not an authority waiver for WP-O20's final-event binding mismatch.
The queried GitHub record has no exact-final-head APPROVED review; this absence does not prove that no off-platform human judgment occurred.
No live provider is invoked and no live benchmark, production capability, production routing, deployment, promotion, or ACTIVE_TRACK closure is authorized.
If post-merge ratification is intended to grant governance authority rather than classify evidence, the Arena owner must make that separate explicit choice before merge.

This reseal is bound to origin/main 8965ffa93a593c760ead6a76c94c4bc489e5cf93; any later main movement before merge requires another rebase and reseal. This packet does not make its draft PR mergeable.
session_entry.rollback: Revert only the new PR #983 ratification witness and this WP-R983 packet; preserve historical WP-O20, Arena runtime/tests, ACTIVE_TRACK, and generated projections unchanged.
